Hello=20
I am currently helping some colleagues in the design of a survey for =
abundance estimation of snakes in dunes, a habitat where the topography =
is definitely not plane. I have been looking for references on abundance =
estimation of snakes using Distance sampling and could not found =
anything. If anyone knows references on abundance estimation of snakes =
or other organisms in a dune-like habitat, please let me know. It would =
be very helpful.

Thank you in advance for your attention

Daniel Danilewicz

dani...@terra.com.br and danil...@hotmail.com







=20
